caption_txt.title: Stressed About the Student Visa Changes? Come and Ask Your Questions — 6–16 October
body: We know many of you have been affected by the recent student visa changes and are feeling stressed — especially if your student visa is about to expire very soon.

From 6 to 16 October, Monday to Friday between 1 PM and 2 PM, come and meet Rahul Dhanda, Director & Registered Migration Agent at PFEC Global Parramatta (MARN 2418640), and our team at our Sydney and Parramatta offices. We'll help you understand your current situation and try to answer all your questions.
bullets: 📍 PFEC Global Sydney — Ste 402, Level 4/447 Kent St, Sydney NSW 2000
📍 PFEC Global Parramatta — Ground Floor, 1/21 George Street, Parramatta NSW 2150
💬 Come in and ask your questions
caption_txt.urgency: Don't wait — come in, ask your questions and get clarity.
